excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, Doubao released multiple updates for productivity scenarios, including an upgraded "work task mode" interface. A new sidebar workbench has been added to the right side of the "Chat" page, consolidating task-related resources in a multi-tab format, allowing AI conversations and hands-on operations to take place on the same screen without frequent window switching. The sidebar workbench supports opening local files, Feishu Docs, online web pages, as well as code, apps, and terminals, covering the main scenarios of daily office work and application development. For long tasks, multiple outputs generated in the conversation—such as apps, files, and images—are displayed side by side in tabs for one-click viewing. Each conversation has its own independent workbench, and switching tasks automatically restores the previous state, preventing scattered outputs and difficult backtracking in long conversations. In application development scenarios, the sidebar workbench supports real-time code preview. After generating a webpage, users can click the "Edit" button to fine-tune specific details without regenerating the entire page. For office documents, Feishu Docs, PPT, and Excel can all be opened directly in the sidebar workbench, and model-generated content updates to the document instantly, eliminating the need for copy-paste and re-saving. In addition, the model can directly browse and operate web pages within the sidebar workbench, independently performing searches, clicks, page turns, and information extraction based on user instructions, and organizing summaries based on web content. excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, Doubao ha lanzado varias actualizaciones en torno a escenarios de productividad, y la interfaz del «modo de tareas de trabajo» también se ha mejorado. En el lado derecho de la página «Conversación» se ha añadido un banco de trabajo lateral, que unifica los recursos relacionados con las tareas mediante múltiples pestañas, permitiendo que la conversación con IA y las operaciones reales se realicen en la misma pantalla, sin necesidad de cambiar con frecuencia entre múltiples ventanas. Según se ha informado, el banco de trabajo lateral admite abrir archivos locales, documentos de Feishu, páginas web en línea, así como código, aplicaciones y terminal, cubriendo los principales escenarios de trabajo diario y desarrollo de aplicaciones. Para tareas largas, las aplicaciones, archivos, imágenes y otros productos generados en la conversación se muestran en paralelo en forma de pestañas, con solo hacer clic para verlos; cada conversación tiene su propio banco de trabajo independiente, y al cambiar de tarea se restaura automáticamente.

excerpt_i18n.en: In recent years, as domestic competition intensifies and new models such as fully managed services emerge, a growing number of domestic trade merchants have begun expanding overseas in search of new business opportunities. At the same time, many brands that grew up in overseas markets are now ramping up efforts to develop their domestic operations—examples include consumer electronics brands like Anker and OnePlus. Under this two-way flow, the integrated development of domestic and foreign trade is becoming the new normal for a growing number of enterprises. According to data from the Ministry of Commerce, as many as 87,000 industrial enterprises above designated size have achieved integrated domestic and foreign trade operations. Walking on two legs—domestic and foreign trade—brings double the opportunities, but it also drives operational complexity up exponentially. Domestic e-commerce, cross-border e-commerce, B2B, and B2C each follow completely different operational logics; the demographics and consumer preferences across different platforms and channels also differ significantly. These dimensions intersect, making operations suddenly far more difficult. Relying purely on manpower is no longer enough to cope with such a complex landscape. Business can be conducted across multiple platforms, but can management and operations exist on one and only one platform? Driven by this strong demand, Accio, which already has 10 million users in the cross-border e-commerce space, has broken through barriers to connect with major domestic platforms including Taobao, Tmall, Pinduoduo, JD.com, and Douyin Store. Multiple e-commerce platforms, one AI workstation—this is exactly what has emerged. The e-commerce AI Agent has also begun integrating domestic and foreign trade. Accio was originally an AI Agent launched by Alibaba International on the Alibaba.com platform, designed specifically to help B2B foreign trade business owners run their businesses.
excerpt_i18n.es: En los últimos años, con la intensificación de la competencia interna y el impulso de nuevos modelos como la gestión integral, cada vez más comerciantes del mercado interior empiezan a salir al extranjero en busca de nuevas oportunidades de negocio. Al mismo tiempo, muchas marcas que han crecido en los mercados internacionales también están empezando a operar en el mercado nacional, como las marcas de productos electrónicos de consumo Anker y OnePlus, entre otras. Con este flujo bidireccional, la integración del comercio interior y exterior se está convirtiendo en la nueva normalidad para un número creciente de empresas. Según datos del Ministerio de Comercio, solo entre las empresas industriales por encima del tamaño designado, 87.000 han logrado operar de forma integrada en el comercio interior y exterior. Caminar sobre las dos piernas del comercio interior y exterior ofrece el doble de oportunidades, pero también multiplica exponencialmente la complejidad de la gestión. excerpt_i18n.en: Database software, with over 60 years of history, is now accelerating its restructuring for Agents. On August 20, at the 2026 DTCC China Database Technology Conference, Tencent Cloud officially released TDSQL Nexa, an AI-era data foundation. It connects enterprises' scattered multi-source data through a unified entry point and provides Agents with business semantics understanding and permission governance capabilities. At the same time, Tencent Cloud also announced the latest AI progress across its database products, with multiple capabilities already deployed in Tencent's internal AI products, developer tools, and enterprise production environments. Wang Yicheng, Vice President of Tencent Cloud, stated that the changes brought by Agents go beyond adding a new type of database user—data formats, workload patterns, context requirements, and security boundaries are all shifting. For the AI era, databases need four core capabilities: unified multi-model support, Agent-native architecture, semantics and memory, and governance with autonomy. (Image: Wang Yicheng, Vice President of Tencent Cloud, releasing TDSQL Nexa on site) One entry point to help Agents understand enterprise data. When enterprises build AI applications, data is often scattered across multiple technology stacks and platforms. If an Agent needs to search and retrieve data across multiple systems, development, operations, and permission management become complex.
